messages:
maria: Quick sync We need a concise launch copy bundle for the site + social + webinar page. Focus: clear CTAs per deployment mode, short benchmark line, webinar sign-up hooks, and inbound routing. Deadline: end of week.
scott: I'll draft 3 headline concepts for the hero (engineering tone) and the benchmark blurb. Want to use a single metric callout for each mode.
tom: I'll draft the social cadence + two tweet threads and the webinar landing copy. Thinking of framing the webinar as a workshop: 'Reduce inference cost in production'.
elaine: Reminder: Dedicated needs "reserved GPU pools" + SLA mention. Private must include KMS/HSM and on-prem options. Keep the private blurb short and non-technical on the hero, detail in the body.
nora: Routing notes: We should create 3 distinct demo URLs so leads auto-tag: /demo-hosted, /demo-dedicated, /demo-private. Form fields: deployment preference, monthly tokens, contact urgency. Add utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tri-launch on all posts.
samir: Can we get a one-line benchmark that fits in a tweet? I propose: "95th-pct latency <120ms • up to 3x token cost savings vs baseline" — engineering signoff needed.
launch-bot: webinar draft created for 2026-05-19 09:00 PT. Reminders set 7 days and 1 day before.
maria: Good. We also need three short CTAs to A/B test across hero, posts, and webinar CTA buttons. Keep them action-first and mode-specific.
scott: CTA candidates: ["Start hosted trial", "Reserve dedicated capacity", "Schedule private demo"] 
samir: Social-ready benchmark line variant: "95th-pct latency <120ms; 3x token cost reduction in our tests." Shorter alt: "<120ms 95th-pct • 3x token savings."
tom: Proposed webinar subject lines (A/B): A) "Cut inference costs without giving up latency" B) "How teams run predictable LLM inference at scale". Landing hero for webinar: "Live workshop: Inference patterns for cost, latency, and reliability."
elaine: Engineering will confirm benchmark statement by Tue 17:00 PT. Security will review the Private page copy by Wed 12:00 PT (HSM/KMS language).
maria: OK. Assignments: scott = hero copy + benchmark blurb; tom = social + webinar page; nora = routing URLs and form; elaine = compliance checks; samir = headline UX review. Deliver drafts by Thu EOD.
nora: I'll provision the three demo endpoints and set up the sales queues: fast-trial (hosted) and enterprise (dedicated + private). Will share the mapping spreadsheet once done.
scott: Draft hero snippets (quick): 1) "Predictable LLM inference. Hosted, reserved, or on-prem." 2) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost." 3) "One API, three deployment modes for production inference." Which one resonates?
tom: I like #2 for product homepage, #1 for mode overview. For social copy sample (teaser): "New: Redwood Inference Run high-throughput LLMs with lower cost and consistent latency. Webinar 5/19. Register -> {shortlink}"
emma: (reaction) :thumbsup:
maria: Great thread. Remember to include UTM links and demo paths in every CTA. We'll review drafts Thu 10am PT. Thanks everyone.
